title: Travel: Paul McCartney – London to Antigua | 1969
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney flew from London to Antigua on 10 December 1969.

They took with them their daughters Heather and Mary for the winter holiday. They stayed at the Curtain Bluff Resort in the south of the island.

The McCartneys got in the habit of leaving candied fruit on the walls near their apartment for the local birds.

We put cherries out for the birds. We’d get them from the bar, glacé cherries, and put them out, so there’s pictures with loads of birds on there.
Paul McCartney, 2011
McCartney album reissue

One of Linda’s photographs of cherries on a wall was used on the cover of Paul’s debut solo album McCartney.

The McCartneys returned to London shortly before Christmas.
